description: The on-chain immune attestation of an Arc token (ImmuneAttestations on Arc mainnet): grade A/B healthy, C watch, D sick, F infected, ? unproven, the sha256 evidence hash and the block it was written in. Read it before you buy: a public chain record, not a fresh check (a fresh one is arc_immune). attested:false means nobody bought a deep check of that token yet, which is not a clean bill of health. $0.001 per call over x402.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the same base64 payload you would put in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Pass it here and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
